name: archive-clean
description: Archiving a finished quest whose work is merged removes its checkout and branch, moves its records to quests/.archived, and says so in the record, leaving the realm's repository and upstream alone.

graders.name: realm-repo-untouched
graders.run: test "$(git -C app symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" = main && git -C app diff --quiet && test -z "$(git -C app status --porcelain)"

graders.name: upstream-untouched
graders.run: git -C upstream/app.git log --format=%s main | head -1 | grep -qx 'Name the shop in the README title' && ! git -C upstream/app.git rev-parse --verify -q readme-title

graders.name: record-says-archived
graders.criteria: Current State says the quest is archived and that its checkout was removed.
